import pytest
from aiohttp.cookiejar import CookieJar
from yarl import URL
import time
import calendar
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Iterable


def test_cookiejar_init() -> None:
    jar = CookieJar()
    assert jar.unsafe is False
    assert jar.quote_cookie is True
    assert jar.treat_as_secure_origin == frozenset()


def test_cookiejar_init_with_params() -> None:
    jar = CookieJar(unsafe=True, quote_cookie=False, treat_as_secure_origin=URL('https://example.com'))
    assert jar.unsafe is True
    assert jar.quote_cookie is False
    assert jar.treat_as_secure_origin == frozenset({URL('https://example.com').origin()})


def test_cookiejar_cookies_property() -> None:
    jar = CookieJar()
    jar.update_cookies({'cookie1': 'value1'}, URL('http://example.com'))
    assert len(jar.cookies) == 1


def test_cookiejar_host_only_cookies_property() -> None:
    jar = CookieJar()
    jar.update_cookies({'cookie1': 'value1'}, URL('http://example.com'))
    assert len(jar.host_only_cookies) == 1


def test_cookiejar_save_and_load() -> None:
    jar = CookieJar()
    jar.update_cookies({'cookie1': 'value1'}, URL('http://example.com'))
    temp_file = Path('temp_cookies.json')
    jar.save(temp_file)
    new_jar = CookieJar()
    new_jar.load(temp_file)
    assert len(new_jar.cookies) == 1
    os.remove(temp_file)


def test_cookiejar_clear() -> None:
    jar = CookieJar()
    jar.update_cookies({'cookie1': 'value1'}, URL('http://example.com'))
    jar.clear()
    assert len(jar.cookies) == 0


def test_cookiejar_clear_domain() -> None:
    jar = CookieJar()
    jar.update_cookies({'cookie1': 'value1'}, URL('http://example.com'))
    jar.clear_domain('example.com')
    assert len(jar.cookies) == 0


def test_cookiejar_iter() -> None:
    jar = CookieJar()
    jar.update_cookies({'cookie1': 'value1'}, URL('http://example.com'))
    assert len(list(jar)) == 1


def test_cookiejar_len() -> None:
    jar = CookieJar()
    jar.update_cookies({'cookie1': 'value1'}, URL('http://example.com'))
    assert len(jar) == 1


def test_cookiejar_do_expiration() -> None:
    jar = CookieJar()
    jar.update_cookies({'cookie1': 'value1'}, URL('http://example.com'))
    jar._expire_cookie(time.time() - 1, 'example.com', '/', 'cookie1')
    jar._do_expiration()
    assert len(jar.cookies) == 0


def test_cookiejar_expire_cookie() -> None:
    jar = CookieJar()
    jar.update_cookies({'cookie1': 'value1'}, URL('http://example.com'))
    jar._expire_cookie(time.time() + 10, 'example.com', '/', 'cookie1')

def test_add_get_basic(loop):
    async def handler(request):
        return web.Response(text='Hello, world!')

        assert match_info is not None
        response = await match_info.handler(request)
        assert response.status == 200
        assert await response.text() == 'Hello, world!'

    loop.run_until_complete(run_url_dispatcher_benchmark())

import asyncio

from aiohttp import DataQueue, WSMessage, WSMsgType, WSCloseCode
from aiohttp.http_websocket import WebSocketReader

def test_feed_eof(loop: asyncio.AbstractEventLoop) -> None:
    queue: DataQueue[WSMessage] = DataQueue(loop=loop)
    reader = WebSocketReader(queue, max_msg_size=2**16)
    reader.feed_eof()
    assert queue._eof

def test_feed_data_empty(loop: asyncio.AbstractEventLoop) -> None:
    queue: DataQueue[WSMessage] = DataQueue(loop=loop)
    reader = WebSocketReader(queue, max_msg_size=2**16)
    result = reader.feed_data(b'')
    assert result == (False, b'')

def test_feed_data_invalid_opcode(loop: asyncio.AbstractEventLoop) -> None:
    queue: DataQueue[WSMessage] = DataQueue(loop=loop)
    reader = WebSocketReader(queue, max_msg_size=2**16)
    invalid_frame = b'\x82\x01a'  # Invalid opcode (2)
    result = reader.feed_data(invalid_frame)
    assert result == (True, b'')
    assert isinstance(queue._exception, WebSocketError)
    assert queue._exception.code == WSCloseCode.PROTOCOL_ERROR

def test_feed_data_message_too_big(loop: asyncio.AbstractEventLoop) -> None:
    queue: DataQueue[WSMessage] = DataQueue(loop=loop)
    reader = WebSocketReader(queue, max_msg_size=10)
    large_frame = b'\x81\x0bHello, World!'  # Message size 13
    result = reader.feed_data(large_frame)
    assert result == (True, b'')
    assert isinstance(queue._exception, WebSocketError)
    assert queue._exception.code == WSCloseCode.MESSAGE_TOO_BIG

def test_feed_data_invalid_utf8(loop: asyncio.AbstractEventLoop) -> None:

    reader = WebSocketReader(queue, max_msg_size=2**16)
    invalid_utf8_frame = b'\x81\x03\xff\xff\xff'  # Invalid UTF-8
    result = reader.feed_data(invalid_utf8_frame)
    assert result == (True, b'')
    assert isinstance(queue._exception, WebSocketError)
    assert queue._exception.code == WSCloseCode.INVALID_TEXT

def test_feed_data_close_frame(loop: asyncio.AbstractEventLoop) -> None:
    queue: DataQueue[WSMessage] = DataQueue(loop=loop)
